{{Quote|There's an ancient temple there still. It was serviced for centuries by the Dark Prophets. It's so steeped in the dark side that it formed its own nexus-one so powerful it interferes with all weaponry and technology except for lightsabers.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on the danger within the Dark Force Temple|<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sith Jedi Statues''' protected the [[Dark Force Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]],<ref name="MOTS" /> once inhabited by the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]], known practitioners of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]].<ref name="DFS" />

The [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] Jedi statues, silent and motionless, guarded the Temple alongside [[Unidentified Sith statues|Sith statues]], [[Sith undead]], and other [[Sithspawn/Legends|twisted Sith creations]]. Unlike the [[Sword/Legends|sword-bearing]] Sith statues, the Jedi statues wielded [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]; [[Color/Legends|gold]] guardians held red sabers while the grey protected the Temple with yellow blades. Their [[Stone/Legends|stone]] bodies were animated by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] energy of trespassers, feeding off of them through [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]]. Once fueled, their lightsaber ignited, and the automatons attacked the intruder.<ref name="MOTS" /> Any non-lightsaber wielder who met them was doomed since the Dark Force aura of the Temple's [[Vergence/Legends|nexus]] disabled all mechanical weapons except lightsabers.<ref name="Ascension" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, we can deduce that ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Reciprocal apprenticeship|master-and-apprentice]] to [[Kyle Katarn]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]],<ref name="DS1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|serieslink=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref> fought through the statues to [[Mission to Dromund Kaas (New Republic)|save]] her friend from the Temple. When she destroyed the Force-driven guardians, their bodies exploded with a flash of light and a howl.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Yun CGI.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Yun's model]]
{{Quote|Eternal guardians of the Sith temples, the statues are animated by trespassing beings, whose Force energy powers their stone bodies.|''Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith'' instruction manual|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
The enemy appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''. While the name ''Sith Jedi'' is oxymoronic, this is the production name of the enemy unit in the ''Mysteries of the Sith'' instruction manual. The in-game statue models were based on the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Yun]] and [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] from ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'', using the same animations and similar textures for the gold and grey statues respectively.<ref name="MOTS" />
